description: This file defines a React functional component named SuggestionsPanel, which renders a UI panel displaying a list of suggestion items. It includes auxiliary components for icons and utilizes props to customize its display based on suggested items.

methods.name: pillForImpact
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string based on the impact level ('low', 'medium', 'high') to style the impact indicator.

methods.name: SunIcon
methods.description: Renders an SVG icon representing the sun, used in the panel header.

methods.name: ZapIcon
methods.description: Renders an SVG icon resembling a lightning bolt, used to symbolize suggestions.

methods.name: ArrowUpRightIcon
methods.description: Renders an SVG arrow pointing up and right, used alongside action buttons.

methods.name: SuggestionsPanel
methods.description: Main React component that displays a panel with a list of suggestions, handling both empty and populated states.
